summary: Clackamas County, OR lookout site in Mt. Hood NF: 1928 camp, c.1936 cabin and wooden tower, 1941 manned, 1942-43 Aircraft Warning station; gone by 1960s.

facts.design: Rag camp built 1928; cabin and wooden tower added around 1936
facts.status_note: Lookout gone by the 1960s; no source describes what remains on the site today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mt. Hood National Forest)

events.note: Rag camp built on this site
Cabin built around 1936; Firelookout.com describes a cabin and wooden tower
Lookout manned 73 days; reports to a reporting station at Oak Grove; communications by Estacada Telephone and Telegraph
Activated September 12, 1942 as Aircraft Warning Service station Tare 1-4, Portland Filter Center
Deactivated October 16, 1943; site retained by the Forest Service for fire detection
Free balloon, thought to be of Japanese origin, recovered in wooded country about ten miles southeast of Estacada (Oregonian, January 2, 1945); spot a quarter-mile north of the Hillockburn road
Gone by the 1960s; the sources give only the decade, so 1960 marks the start of it and is not a removal date

resolved_conflicts.field: date of the cabin and tower
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a cabin was built around 1936 and mentions no tower; firelookout.com says '1936: cabin, wooden tower'. Both are kept; the story describes the wooden tower only as firelookout.com's wording.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: status gone, U.S. Forest Service, elevation 725 m and 2010 FFLOS registration all match the register; no corrections. The brief lists a second coordinate set (West US Lookouts: 45.1941, -122.2411) about 1 km from the register's 45.18471, -122.24513; that page was not read, so the conflict is noted here, not resolved. The register's coordinates are the ones matched. The sources give no removal year (gone 'by the 1960s'); the 1960 event year is a decade marker only. The 1945 balloon is a Hillockburn-area find, not a find at the lookout, and the story says so. The Forest Service trail #516 page covers a trail from Forest Road 45 to the South Fork Clackamas River and mentions no lookout; it is cited only for the road closure, and the story says the page does not mention the lookout. No photos added: the register photos carry no licence. Budget: 2 searches and 6 page reads (firetower, firelookout, Forest Lookouts, two reads of the trail #516 page, and an Oregon Hikers trailhead page which had no lookout mention).
